# FrugalDomain

> Free browser-based tools for developers and designers, in English and Arabic.
> Icons, image/audio/document conversion, a vector editor, AI-adjacent
> developer utilities, and a library of ready-made HTML interface templates.

Everything below runs in the visitor's browser unless the page says otherwise:
nothing is uploaded, there is no account, no quota and no trial period. Arabic
is a first-class language here rather than a translation layer — the Arabic
pages carry their own copy and the tools handle Arabic text deliberately.

## Developer tools

- [Developer tools hub](https://frugaldomain.site/tools): Index of every browser-based developer tool on the site.
- [Token and cost calculator](https://frugaldomain.site/token-calculator): Estimate prompt tokens and cost across thirty models from seven providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, xAI, DeepSeek, Mistral, open-weight hosts). Counts Arabic separately, because tokenisers pack it far less efficiently. Every price carries the date it was checked and a link to the source.
- [AGENTS.md generator](https://frugaldomain.site/agents-md): Generates the instruction file a coding agent reads when it opens a repository, as AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules or Copilot instructions.
- [Fine-tuning JSONL validator](https://frugaldomain.site/jsonl-validator): Checks a training file line by line for JSON errors, unusable roles, empty content, duplicate examples and token cost per example — before the upload rather than after it.
- [Arabic text toolkit](https://frugaldomain.site/arabic-text): Normalises Arabic for a search index or a training set: strips diacritics and tatweel, unifies alef/ya/hamza, converts Arabic-Indic digits, and names the invisible characters that corrupt datasets.
- [JSON toolkit](https://frugaldomain.site/json-toolkit): Format, validate, sort keys, compare two documents by path rather than by line, and convert to TypeScript interfaces, CSV or YAML.
- [Arabic mock data generator](https://frugaldomain.site/mock-data): Seeded fake rows with Arabic names, real city names and local phone formats for Syria, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Egypt and Morocco. Exports JSON, NDJSON, CSV, SQL or TypeScript.
- [SVG toolkit](https://frugaldomain.site/svg-toolkit): Optimises an SVG and converts it to React JSX, Vue, React Native, Flutter, Android VectorDrawable, a data URI or CSS.
- [Favicon and app icon generator](https://frugaldomain.site/favicon-generator): One logo into favicon.ico, PNG tab icons, the opaque iOS touch icon, Android icons, a maskable icon, a manifest and the HTML snippet.

## Converters and editors

- [Image converter](https://frugaldomain.site/ImageConvert): Convert between PNG, JPG, WebP, AVIF and more, locally.
- [Audio converter](https://frugaldomain.site/AudioConvert): MP3, WAV, OGG and AAC, via FFmpeg compiled to WebAssembly.
- [Document converter](https://frugaldomain.site/FileConvert): DOCX and XLSX to PDF, including Arabic text that most converters mangle.
- [Vector editor](https://frugaldomain.site/vector-editor): Draw, clip, combine and export vector artwork.
- [Drawing board](https://frugaldomain.site/Drower/Board): The editor itself, with around three hundred editable templates.
- [Touch simulator](https://frugaldomain.site/Drower/TouchSimulator): Handwriting and gesture data collection.

## Single-conversion pages

- [JPG to PNG](https://frugaldomain.site/convert/jpg-to-png)
- [PNG to JPG](https://frugaldomain.site/convert/png-to-jpg)

- [WebP to PNG](https://frugaldomain.site/convert/webp-to-png)
- [JPG to WebP](https://frugaldomain.site/convert/jpg-to-webp)
- [PNG to GIF](https://frugaldomain.site/convert/png-to-gif)

## Libraries

- [Icon library](https://frugaldomain.site/IconsGalary): Hundreds of icons in SVG and PNG, served over a CDN or copied out as JSX.
- [Component library](https://frugaldomain.site/components): Interface templates — tables, forms, dashboards — each a single self-contained HTML file.
- [Apps gallery](https://frugaldomain.site/apps): Applications published on FrugalDomain, each with docs and a live browser demo.

## Arabic site

The Arabic pages are not machine translations; each carries its own copy and
routes into the shared tool at its English URL.

- [الصفحة الرئيسية](https://frugaldomain.site/ar)
